_doc: A stranger's forge.json (docs/portable-design.md section 4): every integration off, nothing of anyone's machine, every table empty. bin/forge init switches on what it detects. Keys that start with _ are documentation. integrations: codex, gsd and hindsight, each true or false, a missing key is false. codex_harness: only read with integrations.codex on; true configures Codex like Claude Code (forge writes its hook rows into ~/.codex/hooks.json and each project's MCP servers into .codex/config.toml), false or missing writes neither and takes out only what forge wrote there (the .agents/skills links and AGENTS.md stay either way). gsd_patches: false (or missing) is GSD unpatched, straight from its package, installed by forge init with `pnpm dlx get-shit-done-cc`; true is the maintainer's patched, staged copy (sync_gsd_runtime.py) and is not offered to a stranger. user_settings: the plain defaults and env keys written into ~/.claude/settings.json. user_hooks: [{event, command, timeout, marker, matcher, agents, on}] rows reconciled like the engine's own. skill_keep: the tables sync_skill_keep.py applies (sets, design_permissions, extras, no_gsd_baseline, common_skills, common_permissions, common_env, common_plugins, common_opt_out, common_exclude). session_wait: {project, health, unit}, left out when no session start has to wait for a local server. instruction_files_skip: profile names forge doctor does not check. lock_exclude: plugin names (name@marketplace) that forge lock leaves out of config/forge.lock.json, because that file is published. doctor_extra: [name, argv, fix] rows added to forge doctor.
